title: quantityDeclarationData
description: Quantity declaration context containing the network location, internal balancing group, covered period, time-series granularity, unit and declared quantity values.

internalAccount.description: Internal balancing group identifier for which the quantity declaration is submitted.

period.description: Period covered by the quantity declaration, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

granularity.description: Duration of each quantity declaration interval. PT15M represents a quarter-hour and PT1H represents one hour.

values.description: Chronologically ordered quantity declaration values. Each value represents the declared quantity for one interval. The interval duration is defined by quantityDeclarationData.granularity.

quantity.description: Non-negative whole-number quantity declared for the interval in the unit defined by unit.
